name: Elena Vargas
bio:
Elena Vargas' journey into motorsport security was unconventional. After a career in the Mexican Federal Police, where she specialized in high-risk transport and protection details, Elena sought a new challenge. Her tactical acumen and meticulous planning caught the eye of a team manager during a local rally event, leading to her transition into motorsport security. 

At Carlin, Elena's focus is preventative security. She believes in identifying and mitigating potential risks before they escalate, fostering a safe and secure environment for the entire team. Her detail-oriented approach and no-nonsense attitude have earned her the respect of her colleagues, even if her methods are occasionally perceived as overly cautious. Elena is distinctive for her ability to anticipate and neutralize threats, earning her the nickname 'La Muralla' (The Wall) within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with subtle graying at the temples.
physical.description: Elena is a stout woman with a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with detailed security protocols and risk assessments.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting all delivery vehicles entering the team's paddock area.
